== Acquisition ==
This skill can be temporarily acquired by [[Primary profession|primary]] [[Assassin]]s by talking to [[Kuunavang]] in [[Raisu Palace]], [[Imperial Sanctum]] or [[Raisu Palace (explorable area)]].

== Notes ==
* The skill descriptions omit that this skill can only be recharged when gaining a [[Morale Boost]].
* Despite their appearance, Celestial Assassins are not [[minion]]s: they do not have inherent [[health degeneration]], do not turn [[Masterless minion|hostile]] when their master is killed, and [[Health regeneration#Automatic regeneration|regenerate health outside of combat]] like normal [[creature]]s.
* Although Celestial Assassins do not follow the party, they continue to go attack foes that are [[aggro]]ed by a party member.
